verdict.rationale: Trello documents checklists with per-item due dates, which can serve as subtasks within a card, and a 'Link cards' feature. But nothing in the evidence shows dependency or blocking relationships between cards, so blocking order is not made clear. missing for 10: documented dependency/blocking links between tasks, any visualization of blocking order, in-depth docs on subtask (checklist) behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
